{{Quote|Corporal, you and I will refuel in this fine establishment.|[[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]] to [[WAC-47/Legends|WAC-47]]|<ref name="Missing in Action">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref>}}
'''Power Sliders''' was a diner located in the city of [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The front sign read '''Ower Sliders''' after the first letter had fallen off.<ref name="SW-Missing in Action Episode Guide | The Clone Wars">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/missing-in-action-episode-guide|text="Missing in Action" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref> It was located beside [[Game Go/Legends|Game Go]].

The eatery did not allow the entrance of [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Additionally, it did not serve [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]], a member of the [[Zilkin/Legends|Zilkin]] species, who wanted to order the special of the day.

[[File:PowerSlidersGascon-MissingInAction.png|thumb|left|250px|Gascon tries to order in Borkus's diner.]]

The diner served a variety of dishes, including [[Eopie stew/Legends|Eopie stew]], [[Nuna Gumbo/Legends|Nuna Gumbo]], [[Ewok Jerky/Legends|Ewok Jerky]] and [[Fambaa Delight/Legends|Fambaa Delight]].

It was run by [[Borkus/Legends|Borkus]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]]. [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commando]] [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]] worked there as a dishwasher after he went [[Amnesia/Legends|missing in action]] in the [[Battle of Sarrish/Legends|Battle of]] [[Sarrish/Legends|Sarrish]].
